subject: Your MCP servers for dev teams post
text:
Hi Naman,

Liked that your best MCP servers post keeps the list short and puts Lockstep where it honestly fits instead of at the top. I run PickAPlugin, a free directory of Codex and ChatGPT plugins and MCP servers, and I'm happy to add the Lockstep MCP server as a free listing if you want it there.

We also put together some numbers on the Codex plugin side: https://pickaplugin.com/research/state-of-codex-plugins-2026
Free to cite with a credit link if it's ever useful for that post or your Codex memory one.

Aaron, PickAPlugin
